I’ll instruct PT to keep Ms. Chen and Mr. Davis on the mid-morning list, but to only see Mr. Lopez after the resident and nurse confirm his analgesia and stable vitals. I’ll notify PT of this now. Then, I plan to check on Ms. Chen at 10:30 after PT and nursing ambulation to confirm her readiness for discharge. Lopez's heart rate is between 102-105 with 8/10 pain, so I’ll request an analgesic adjustment and recheck his vitals before he ambulates—I'll page the resident now. For the charge snapshot: Ms. Chen (POD2 chole) is likely to discharge today if she ambulates mid-morning, tolerates oral intake, and has pain at or below 4, along with nurse and physician sign-off. Mr. Davis (POD3 lysis) is also a possible discharge today if PT ambulation goes well. I’ll reassess Chen after the PT/nursing ambulation by 10:30, holding off on placement unless I confirm necessary. Lastly, I’ll update the attending at mid-morning rounds.
